#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fill ConfigHub with this Flux fleet: one base per layer, one variant per
# cluster, one Target per cluster. Written by `cub flux apply`. Read it,
# then run it:
#
#   bash apply.sh
#
# Nothing here touches a cluster. Flux goes on reconciling Git throughout,
# and ConfigHub ends up holding a parallel copy that nothing reads.
# handover.sh is what moves the fleet onto it; until you run that, deleting
# these Spaces puts you back exactly where you started.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
step() { printf '\n== %s\n' "$*"; }
# Flux paths are written from the top of the repository, so the script needs
# to know where that is.
REPO_ROOT=${REPO_ROOT:-'<repo>'}
[ -d "$REPO_ROOT" ] || { echo "REPO_ROOT=$REPO_ROOT is not a directory: point it at the repository checkout"; exit 1; }

rolled_out() { [ "$(cub changeorder get --space "${1%/*}" "${1#*/}" -o jq=.ChangeOrder.Stage)" = Completed ]; }
# A variant must hold every unit of its base before it is released: Flux
# prunes from a cluster whatever a release no longer holds.
holds() {
  local n; n=$(cub unit list --space "$1" -o jq=length)
  [ "$n" -ge "$2" ] || { echo "$1 holds $n of its $2 units; run this script again" >&2; return 1; }
}
stages_are() { [ "$(cub changeworkflow get --space "$1" "$2" -o 'jq=[.ChangeWorkflow.Stages[].Name] | join(",")')" = "$3" ]; }
promote() {
  local out
  for _ in 1 2 3; do
    out=$(cub variant promote --change-order "$1" --target-stage "$2" --quiet 2>&1 >/dev/null) && return 0
    case "$out" in *"nothing left to promote"*) return 0 ;; esac
    sleep 15
  done
  echo "$out" >&2; return 1
}
publish() {
  local out
  holds "$1" "$3" || return 1
  out=$(cub release publish "$1" --revision "ChangeOrder:$2" --quiet 2>&1) && return 0
  case "$out" in *"no changes were made since :latest bundle"*) echo "$1 already released" ;; *) echo "$out" >&2; return 1 ;; esac
}
# Each layer is rendered by kustomize here rather than by the plugin, so
# what ConfigHub stores is exactly what Flux builds today. postBuild
# substitution is Flux's, applied on the cluster, so it is left in place.
render() {
  mkdir -p render
  kustomize build ${KUSTOMIZE_FLAGS:-} "$REPO_ROOT/$1" > "render/$2.yaml"
  [ -s "render/$2.yaml" ] || { echo "kustomize build $REPO_ROOT/$1 rendered nothing" >&2; return 1; }
}

step "0/4 Check before changing anything"
cub space list --quiet >/dev/null || { echo "cub is not logged in: run cub auth login"; exit 1; }
command -v kustomize >/dev/null || { echo "kustomize is not on PATH; the layers are rendered with it"; exit 1; }

step "1/4 One named Target per cluster, in flux-targets"
cub space create flux-targets --allow-exists --quiet
# A server-hosted worker has no process behind it and no role in the
# organization; it holds the Targets and is the credential Flux reads with.
cub worker create --space flux-targets server-worker --is-server-worker --org-role none --allow-exists --quiet
cub target create dev-1 '{}' server-worker --space flux-targets --provider OCI --toolchain Any --allow-exists --quiet
cub target create staging-1 '{}' server-worker --space flux-targets --provider OCI --toolchain Any --allow-exists --quiet
cub target create prod-1 '{}' server-worker --space flux-targets --provider OCI --toolchain Any --allow-exists --quiet

step "2/4 One component per layer: a base holding what it renders to, and a rollout workflow"
cub component create flux-infrastructure --allow-exists --quiet
cub space create flux-infrastructure-base --component flux-infrastructure --label Component=flux-infrastructure --label Role=base --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/base' 'infrastructure-base'
cub unit create --space flux-infrastructure-base infrastructure render/infrastructure-base.yaml --change-desc 'Onboard the infrastructure layer from gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/base' --allow-exists --quiet
cub changeworkflow create --space flux-infrastructure-base rollout --filename infrastructure/change-workflow.yaml --allow-exists --quiet
stages_are flux-infrastructure-base rollout 'dev,staging,prod' || echo '{"Stages":[{"Name":"dev","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''dev'\''","ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]},{"Name":"staging","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''staging'\''","Prerequisites":["Released"],"ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]},{"Name":"prod","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''prod'\''","Prerequisites":["Released"],"ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]}]}' | cub changeworkflow update --patch --space flux-infrastructure-base rollout --from-stdin --quiet
cub component create flux-apps --allow-exists --quiet
cub space create flux-apps-base --component flux-apps --label Component=flux-apps --label Role=base --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/base/apptique' 'apps-base'
cub unit create --space flux-apps-base apps render/apps-base.yaml --change-desc 'Onboard the apps layer from gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/base/apptique' --allow-exists --quiet
cub changeworkflow create --space flux-apps-base rollout --filename apps/change-workflow.yaml --allow-exists --quiet
stages_are flux-apps-base rollout 'dev,staging,prod' || echo '{"Stages":[{"Name":"dev","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''dev'\''","ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]},{"Name":"staging","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''staging'\''","Prerequisites":["Released"],"ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]},{"Name":"prod","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''prod'\''","Prerequisites":["Released"],"ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]}]}' | cub changeworkflow update --patch --space flux-apps-base rollout --from-stdin --quiet
cub component create flux-tenants --allow-exists --quiet
cub space create flux-tenants-base --component flux-tenants --label Component=flux-tenants --label Role=base --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/tenants/base/team-checkout' 'tenants-base'
cub unit create --space flux-tenants-base tenants render/tenants-base.yaml --change-desc 'Onboard the tenants layer from gitops/flux/expert-fleet/tenants/base/team-checkout' --allow-exists --quiet
cub changeworkflow create --space flux-tenants-base rollout --filename tenants/change-workflow.yaml --allow-exists --quiet
stages_are flux-tenants-base rollout 'dev,staging,prod' || echo '{"Stages":[{"Name":"dev","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''dev'\''","ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]},{"Name":"staging","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''staging'\''","Prerequisites":["Released"],"ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]},{"Name":"prod","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''prod'\''","Prerequisites":["Released"],"ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]}]}' | cub changeworkflow update --patch --space flux-tenants-base rollout --from-stdin --quiet
cub component create flux-image-automation --allow-exists --quiet
cub space create flux-image-automation-base --component flux-image-automation --label Component=flux-image-automation --label Role=base --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/image-automation' 'image-automation-base'
cub unit create --space flux-image-automation-base image-automation render/image-automation-base.yaml --change-desc 'Onboard the image-automation layer from gitops/flux/expert-fleet/image-automation' --allow-exists --quiet
cub changeworkflow create --space flux-image-automation-base rollout --filename image-automation/change-workflow.yaml --allow-exists --quiet
stages_are flux-image-automation-base rollout 'dev' || echo '{"Stages":[{"Name":"dev","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''dev'\''","ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]}]}' | cub changeworkflow update --patch --space flux-image-automation-base rollout --from-stdin --quiet

step "3/4 One variant per cluster, each holding what its own path renders to"
cub variant create dev-1 flux-infrastructure-base --stage dev --space-pattern template:flux-infrastructure-dev-1 --target flux-targets/dev-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=dev-1 --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/dev' 'flux-infrastructure-dev-1'
cub unit update --space flux-infrastructure-dev-1 infrastructure render/flux-infrastructure-dev-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/dev renders for dev-1' --quiet
holds flux-infrastructure-dev-1 1
cub variant create staging-1 flux-infrastructure-base --stage staging --space-pattern template:flux-infrastructure-staging-1 --target flux-targets/staging-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=staging-1 --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/staging' 'flux-infrastructure-staging-1'
cub unit update --space flux-infrastructure-staging-1 infrastructure render/flux-infrastructure-staging-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/staging renders for staging-1' --quiet
holds flux-infrastructure-staging-1 1
cub variant create prod-1 flux-infrastructure-base --stage prod --space-pattern template:flux-infrastructure-prod-1 --target flux-targets/prod-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=prod-1 --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/prod' 'flux-infrastructure-prod-1'
cub unit update --space flux-infrastructure-prod-1 infrastructure render/flux-infrastructure-prod-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/prod renders for prod-1' --quiet
holds flux-infrastructure-prod-1 1
cub variant create dev-1 flux-apps-base --stage dev --space-pattern template:flux-apps-dev-1 --target flux-targets/dev-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=dev-1 --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/dev' 'flux-apps-dev-1'
cub unit update --space flux-apps-dev-1 apps render/flux-apps-dev-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/dev renders for dev-1' --quiet
holds flux-apps-dev-1 1
cub variant create staging-1 flux-apps-base --stage staging --space-pattern template:flux-apps-staging-1 --target flux-targets/staging-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=staging-1 --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/staging' 'flux-apps-staging-1'
cub unit update --space flux-apps-staging-1 apps render/flux-apps-staging-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/staging renders for staging-1' --quiet
holds flux-apps-staging-1 1
cub variant create prod-1 flux-apps-base --stage prod --space-pattern template:flux-apps-prod-1 --target flux-targets/prod-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=prod-1 --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/prod' 'flux-apps-prod-1'
cub unit update --space flux-apps-prod-1 apps render/flux-apps-prod-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/prod renders for prod-1' --quiet
holds flux-apps-prod-1 1
cub variant create dev-1 flux-tenants-base --stage dev --space-pattern template:flux-tenants-dev-1 --target flux-targets/dev-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=dev-1 --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/tenants/dev' 'flux-tenants-dev-1'
cub unit update --space flux-tenants-dev-1 tenants render/flux-tenants-dev-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/flux/expert-fleet/tenants/dev renders for dev-1' --quiet
holds flux-tenants-dev-1 1
cub variant create staging-1 flux-tenants-base --stage staging --space-pattern template:flux-tenants-staging-1 --target flux-targets/staging-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=staging-1 --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/tenants/staging' 'flux-tenants-staging-1'
cub unit update --space flux-tenants-staging-1 tenants render/flux-tenants-staging-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/flux/expert-fleet/tenants/staging renders for staging-1' --quiet
holds flux-tenants-staging-1 1
cub variant create prod-1 flux-tenants-base --stage prod --space-pattern template:flux-tenants-prod-1 --target flux-targets/prod-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=prod-1 --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/tenants/prod' 'flux-tenants-prod-1'
cub unit update --space flux-tenants-prod-1 tenants render/flux-tenants-prod-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/flux/expert-fleet/tenants/prod renders for prod-1' --quiet
holds flux-tenants-prod-1 1
cub variant create dev-1 flux-image-automation-base --stage dev --space-pattern template:flux-image-automation-dev-1 --target flux-targets/dev-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=dev-1 --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/image-automation' 'flux-image-automation-dev-1'
cub unit update --space flux-image-automation-dev-1 image-automation render/flux-image-automation-dev-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/flux/expert-fleet/image-automation renders for dev-1' --quiet
holds flux-image-automation-dev-1 1

step "4/4 Release each variant, stage by stage: promote, approve, publish"
cub changeorder create --space flux-infrastructure-base onboard-845737c5 --change-workflow flux-infrastructure-base/rollout --description 'First release of flux-infrastructure-dev-1, flux-infrastructure-staging-1, flux-infrastructure-prod-1' --allow-exists --quiet
if rolled_out flux-infrastructure-base/onboard-845737c5; then
  echo 'infrastructure: every variant in this plan is released'
else
  promote flux-infrastructure-base/onboard-845737c5 dev
  cub variant approve --change-order flux-infrastructure-base/onboard-845737c5 --stage dev --quiet
  publish flux-infrastructure-dev-1 flux-infrastructure-base/onboard-845737c5 1
  promote flux-infrastructure-base/onboard-845737c5 staging
  cub variant approve --change-order flux-infrastructure-base/onboard-845737c5 --stage staging --quiet
  publish flux-infrastructure-staging-1 flux-infrastructure-base/onboard-845737c5 1
  promote flux-infrastructure-base/onboard-845737c5 prod
  cub variant approve --change-order flux-infrastructure-base/onboard-845737c5 --stage prod --quiet
  publish flux-infrastructure-prod-1 flux-infrastructure-base/onboard-845737c5 1
fi
cub changeorder create --space flux-apps-base onboard-45c358b9 --change-workflow flux-apps-base/rollout --description 'First release of flux-apps-dev-1, flux-apps-staging-1, flux-apps-prod-1' --allow-exists --quiet
if rolled_out flux-apps-base/onboard-45c358b9; then
  echo 'apps: every variant in this plan is released'
else
  promote flux-apps-base/onboard-45c358b9 dev
  cub variant approve --change-order flux-apps-base/onboard-45c358b9 --stage dev --quiet
  publish flux-apps-dev-1 flux-apps-base/onboard-45c358b9 1
  promote flux-apps-base/onboard-45c358b9 staging
  cub variant approve --change-order flux-apps-base/onboard-45c358b9 --stage staging --quiet
  publish flux-apps-staging-1 flux-apps-base/onboard-45c358b9 1
  promote flux-apps-base/onboard-45c358b9 prod
  cub variant approve --change-order flux-apps-base/onboard-45c358b9 --stage prod --quiet
  publish flux-apps-prod-1 flux-apps-base/onboard-45c358b9 1
fi
cub changeorder create --space flux-tenants-base onboard-cefd6435 --change-workflow flux-tenants-base/rollout --description 'First release of flux-tenants-dev-1, flux-tenants-staging-1, flux-tenants-prod-1' --allow-exists --quiet
if rolled_out flux-tenants-base/onboard-cefd6435; then
  echo 'tenants: every variant in this plan is released'
else
  promote flux-tenants-base/onboard-cefd6435 dev
  cub variant approve --change-order flux-tenants-base/onboard-cefd6435 --stage dev --quiet
  publish flux-tenants-dev-1 flux-tenants-base/onboard-cefd6435 1
  promote flux-tenants-base/onboard-cefd6435 staging
  cub variant approve --change-order flux-tenants-base/onboard-cefd6435 --stage staging --quiet
  publish flux-tenants-staging-1 flux-tenants-base/onboard-cefd6435 1
  promote flux-tenants-base/onboard-cefd6435 prod
  cub variant approve --change-order flux-tenants-base/onboard-cefd6435 --stage prod --quiet
  publish flux-tenants-prod-1 flux-tenants-base/onboard-cefd6435 1
fi
cub changeorder create --space flux-image-automation-base onboard-3ceb6a03 --change-workflow flux-image-automation-base/rollout --description 'First release of flux-image-automation-dev-1' --allow-exists --quiet
if rolled_out flux-image-automation-base/onboard-3ceb6a03; then
  echo 'image-automation: every variant in this plan is released'
else
  promote flux-image-automation-base/onboard-3ceb6a03 dev
  cub variant approve --change-order flux-image-automation-base/onboard-3ceb6a03 --stage dev --quiet
  publish flux-image-automation-dev-1 flux-image-automation-base/onboard-3ceb6a03 1
fi

echo
echo 'Done. ConfigHub holds this fleet and nothing reads it yet.'
echo 'Flux is still reconciling Git. Read handover.sh next: that is the step that moves it.'
